title.narrative: Capacity (procedures, mechanisms, expertize) of Ombudsman Office, National Human Rights Institution (NHRI), the Parliament and networks of child rights civil society groups to monitor and report on child rights violations(44455), Text

baseline.value: Ombudsman Office, NHRI, Parliament and existing networks of child rights civil society groups have limited capacity to monitor and report on child rights violations

target.value: 2020:Ombudsman Office, NHRI, Parliament and networks of child rights civil society groups have key procedures, mechanisms and expertise in place

actual.value: 2020:OI has upgraded mechanisms and tools for monitoring and reporting in line with its CR Strategy. 2 NGO Networks have enhanced capacity to monitor and report on child rights violations (CRC, CRPD, UPR).
